name: Oats with milk & peanut butter
steps: Simmer the oats in the milk for 3-4 minutes, stirring.
Take off the heat and stir in the peanut butter.
Serve warm. Add sliced fruit if you like.

name: Greek yogurt bowl
steps: Spoon the yogurt into a bowl.
Slice the banana on top.
Add the almonds and chia seeds.

name: Eggs on toast
steps: Boil the eggs for 8-9 minutes, then peel and slice.
Toast the bread and spread the butter.
Top with the eggs, salt and pepper.

name: Omelette with toast
steps: Beat two eggs with salt and chopped chilli.
Cook in a lightly oiled pan until set, folding once.
Serve with toasted bread.

name: Besan chilla with curd
steps: Whisk the besan with water into a pourable batter and add the spices.
Stir in chopped onion and tomato.
Pour onto a hot oiled pan, cook both sides until golden.
Serve with the curd.

name: Paneer bhurji with toast
steps: Heat the oil, fry the onion until soft, then add the tomato and spices.
Crumble in the paneer and cook for 3-4 minutes.
Serve with toast.

name: Tofu scramble on toast
steps: Crumble the tofu and fry the onion in the oil.
Add the tomato, tofu and spices, cook 5 minutes.
Serve on toast.

name: Poha with peanuts & curd
steps: Rinse the poha in a sieve and let it soften.
Temper mustard seeds and curry leaves in oil, add peanuts and onion.
Mix in the poha, salt and turmeric, heat through, finish with lemon.
Serve with the curd.

name: Idli & sambar
steps: Steam the idlis (about 10 minutes) or reheat ready-made ones.
Warm the sambar.
Serve together.

name: Dal, roti & curd
steps: Pressure-cook the toor dal until soft and mash lightly.
Temper cumin and garlic in a little oil and pour over.
Serve with rotis and curd.

name: Rajma rice
steps: Cook soaked rajma until soft (pressure cooker, about 30 minutes) if not already cooked.
Fry onion, ginger-garlic and tomato in oil, add spices.
Add the rajma with a little water and simmer 10 minutes.
Serve over rice.

name: Chole rice
steps: Fry onion, ginger-garlic and tomato in oil with the spices.
Add the cooked chickpeas and simmer 10 minutes.
Serve with rice.

name: Paneer, spinach & roti
steps: Fry the onion and garlic in the oil, add the spinach and spices.
Add paneer cubes and cook 3-4 minutes.
Serve with rotis.

name: Soya chunk pulao
steps: Soak the soya chunks in hot water for 10 minutes, then squeeze dry.
Fry the onion and carrot with spices, add the soya chunks.
Mix in the cooked rice and heat through.

name: Chicken rice bowl
steps: Season the chicken with salt, pepper, garlic and lemon.
Pan-cook in the oil until cooked through (no pink inside), then slice.
Serve over rice with steamed broccoli.

name: Egg curry with rice
steps: Boil the eggs for 8-9 minutes and peel.
Fry onion in the oil, add tomato and spices to make a gravy.
Add the eggs and simmer 5 minutes. Serve with rice.

name: Fish, spinach & rice
steps: Rub the fish with salt, turmeric and lemon.
Pan-cook in the oil 3-4 minutes per side until it flakes.
Serve with rice and sauteed spinach.

name: Tuna quinoa salad
steps: Drain the tuna.
Toss with the quinoa, chopped cucumber and tomato.
Dress with oil, lemon, salt and pepper.

name: Moong khichdi with curd
steps: Cook rice and moong dal together with turmeric and salt until soft.
Temper cumin in the ghee and stir in.
Serve with the curd.

name: Palak dal with rice
steps: Cook the masoor dal until soft.
Add chopped spinach and cook 3 minutes.
Temper cumin and garlic in the oil, pour over, and serve with rice.

name: Tofu stir-fry with rice
steps: Cube the tofu and brown it in the oil.
Add garlic, ginger, broccoli and carrot, stir-fry 4 minutes.
Season and serve over rice.

name: Prawn stir-fry with rice
steps: Fry the onion and garlic in the oil.
Add the prawns and cook until pink and firm.
Add broccoli, season, and serve with rice.

name: Chickpea quinoa bowl
steps: Combine the chickpeas and quinoa.
Add chopped cucumber and tomato.
Season with salt, cumin, lemon and coriander.

name: Chicken roti wrap
steps: Pan-cook the chicken with salt and pepper, then slice.
Mix the curd with chaat masala.
Fill the rotis with chicken, onion, cucumber and the curd sauce.

name: Egg bhurji with roti
steps: Fry the onion in the oil, add tomato and spices.
Pour in beaten eggs and scramble until set.
Serve with rotis.

name: Paneer tikka salad
steps: Marinate paneer cubes in curd and spices for 10 minutes.
Pan-grill in the oil until lightly charred.
Serve over chopped cucumber and tomato with lemon.

name: Whey & milk shake
steps: Blend or shake the whey powder with cold milk until smooth.

name: Curd with almonds
steps: Spoon the curd into a bowl.
Top with chopped almonds.

name: Chickpea chaat
steps: Mix the boiled chickpeas with chopped onion, tomato and cucumber.
Season with chaat masala, salt and lemon.

name: Peanut butter toast
steps: Toast the bread.
Spread the peanut butter on top.

name: Boiled eggs & apple
steps: Boil the eggs for 8-9 minutes, cool and peel.
Season and eat with a sliced apple.

name: Roasted peanuts & banana
steps: Eat the peanuts with the banana.

name: Greek yogurt with walnuts
steps: Spoon the yogurt into a bowl and top with chopped walnuts.

name: Sprouts & paneer chaat
steps: Steam the sprouts for 5 minutes (or use them raw if you prefer).
Mix with cubed paneer and chopped onion, tomato and cucumber.
Season with chaat masala, salt and lemon.
